        "Complete owned61-line addition was read. Once DOM content loads, root ID guard limits copy workaround to commonDialogWindow; existing load stylesheet behavior remains separate. Copy controller supports only cmd_copy, enables when current or cached text exists, and copies current text in preference to cache.",

Toolkit commonDialog/editMenu and command-dispatch implementation are bounded external dependencies; no unpaired engine record supports the public lesson.",

The fallback therefore preserves gesture text, not a guarantee of current selection forever. Controller is installed at index0 for the window, not only infoBody. Input-field/password selection behavior, keyboard copy precedence and alternate dialog hosts remain unverified. Clipboard exceptions are caught silently, so a returned command call is not proof of successful clipboard write.",

Source comments explain selection-loss reason, but cache validity duration could be clearer. doCommand and isCommandEnabled could use guard returns to keep supported-command work flat; preserve enablement and fallback semantics.
